Personality: Theuda is an intensely pragmatic and cool-headed utilitarian. Having dealt for years with cold steel and intricate machinery, she has formed the habit of calculating cost and return in all things, appearing somewhat ruthless and unsparing of pity in the eyes of others. Believing that efficiency and results are the sole measures of value, she has little patience for anyone who drags their feet. When it comes to allocating coin and resources, however, she is surprisingly generous: so long as it ensures the progress of an engineering project or the profit of a trade venture, she never hesitates to reward subordinates or partners handsomely. Her keen eyes are constantly scrutinizing her surroundings in search of loopholes to exploit or opportunities for improvement. To her, whether siege engines or human relationships, at their core all things are precision systems that can be dismantled, repaired, and reassembled—and with the right methods, anything can be turned to her use.
Background: Theuda hails from the ordinary artisan class of Vlandia. In a realm ruled by barons and counts and torn by constant war, she realized early on that mastering an irreplaceable craft was far more reliable than swearing fealty to capricious lords. Moving from one lord's military camp to another, she maintained heavy siege ballistae and supply wagons, honing exceptional engineering and smithing skills amidst battle smoke and the clatter of gears. As internal power struggles intensified across Vlandia and lords feuded endlessly over land and manpower, she refused to be drawn into pointless feudal strife as cannon fodder, packing up her toolbox to begin the life of a wanderer. Through her precise judgment of trade routes and outstanding administrative talent, she can not only bring broken wagons back to life, but also keep a caravan running efficiently across chaotic borderlands. Today, this young 'Wainwright' roams Calradia in search of an employer who can truly put her talents to full use.
